review.criterion: A documentation generator derives the HR role examples from reviewed capability fixtures, links the canonical cross-portal matrix and fails its consistency check when documented actions drift from the fixture definitions.

roles.context: Company administration uses known employee resources; simulated payroll separately requires a chosen period and explicit fictional hourly rates. It cannot impersonate a review author or assigned manager.

Onboarding review and simulated payroll are separate from profile editing and time approval. This role can configure fictional rate timelines and prepare a chosen-period run, but cannot approve or return employee time.
Company people operations exclude compensation and payroll amounts; HR cannot write an assigned manager review.

The actor is employee-001; approval or reasoned return requires submitted unpaid direct-report time and excludes the manager’s own entries. Own unpaid draft time can be corrected or explicitly deleted before resubmission.

The actor is employee-002; self service requires that exact known employee and the current workflow stage. Own unpaid draft time can be corrected or explicitly deleted; submitted, approved and receipted time stays protected.
The actor is contractor-001; its document projection excludes employee records. Contractor UI checklist toggles are local preview state.
Company directory and metadata reads do not permit domain writes; auditor helper projections do not create additional page access.

cases.actionDescription: Save a fictional work email for a known employee.
statePrerequisites: Employee exists in the synthetic fixture.

expected.description: The known employee profile email changes in copied mock state.

cases.actionDescription: Attempt to save another person’s self-review.
statePrerequisites: The review exists in draft; its subject is employee-002.

expected.error: Only the employee can write or submit their own sample self-review.
expected.description: Administrative role does not satisfy the bound self author requirement.

cases.actionDescription: Review the profile prerequisite in employee onboarding.
statePrerequisites: Employee exists; onboarding stage is draft.

expected.description: The profile prerequisite becomes reviewed; onboarding is still draft.

cases.actionDescription: Attempt to change an employee profile email.
statePrerequisites: Employee exists; a payroll role does not grant profile editing.

expected.error: This demo role cannot change that employee profile.
expected.description: Profile editing is refused without modifying the source state.

cases.actionDescription: Approve a known employee’s submitted time entry.
statePrerequisites: Entry belongs to employee-002 and is submitted.

expected.description: The submitted entry becomes approved in copied mock state.

cases.actionDescription: Attempt to write the assigned manager’s review.
statePrerequisites: Review records employee-001 as the assigned manager.

expected.error: Only the assigned direct manager can review or publish this sample cycle.
expected.description: HR administration cannot replace the assigned direct manager.

cases.actionDescription: Approve submitted time for a current direct report.
statePrerequisites: Actor employee-001 is the current manager of employee-002.
The time entry is submitted, and its subject differs from the actor.

expected.description: The direct report’s submitted entry becomes approved.

cases.actionDescription: Attempt to approve a direct report’s draft entry.
statePrerequisites: Actor employee-001 manages employee-003.
The time entry is draft, rather than submitted.

expected.error: Approval requires a submitted entry within this role and team scope; self-approval is unavailable.
expected.description: The reporting line does not bypass the submitted-state prerequisite.

cases.actionDescription: Attempt to approve submitted time outside the actor’s reporting line.
statePrerequisites: Actor employee-003 is a known employee using the manager preview.
Employee-002 reports to employee-001, not employee-003.

expected.error: Approval requires a submitted entry within this role and team scope; self-approval is unavailable.
expected.description: The manager role alone cannot approve another manager’s report.

cases.actionDescription: Attempt to approve the manager’s own submitted time.
statePrerequisites: Actor employee-001 creates and submits their own draft in the setup steps.
The entry is submitted but its employeeId equals the actor.

expected.error: Approval requires a submitted entry within this role and team scope; self-approval is unavailable.
expected.description: Manager self approval is refused even after submission.

cases.actionDescription: Attempt to publish a review before self submission.
statePrerequisites: The actor is the recorded reviewer and current direct manager.
The review is still draft.

expected.error: The employee must submit the self-review before manager review. Published reviews are locked.
expected.description: The correct manager cannot skip the self-submission prerequisite.

cases.actionDescription: Publish a cycle after the employee submits and the assigned manager saves comments.
statePrerequisites: Employee-002 saves and submits their own self-review.
Employee-001 is both the recorded reviewer and current direct manager and saves manager comments.

expected.description: The reviewed cycle becomes a published local sample.

cases.actionDescription: Save a fictional email for the bound employee.
statePrerequisites: Actor employee-002 matches the known employee resource.

expected.description: The bound employee can change their own sample email.

cases.actionDescription: Attempt to edit another employee’s profile using its known ID.
statePrerequisites: Actor remains employee-002; the target is employee-003.

expected.error: This demo role cannot change that employee profile.
expected.description: Knowing a foreign employee ID does not satisfy ownership.

cases.actionDescription: Attempt to confirm an own benefit election before review.
statePrerequisites: The plan is available to employee-002.
The employee has saved an election, but its stage is draft.

expected.error: Review the sample election before confirming.
expected.description: An own election still requires the review transition.

cases.actionDescription: Confirm an own available benefit election after review.
statePrerequisites: The plan is available to employee-002.
The employee elects and reviews the sample before confirmation.

expected.description: The reviewed own election becomes confirmed with a mock receipt.

cases.actionDescription: Attempt to create employee time from a contractor identity.
statePrerequisites: Actor is bound to a contractor, without an employee identity.

expected.error: A bound synthetic employee identity is required.
expected.description: Contractor page access does not grant employee time transitions.

cases.actionDescription: Attempt to approve a visible submitted company time entry.
statePrerequisites: Entry is submitted and belongs to a known employee.
Auditor directory visibility does not grant approval.

expected.error: Approval requires a submitted entry within this role and team scope; self-approval is unavailable.
expected.description: The auditor’s readable metadata does not permit domain mutation.

exportBoundary.description: Every preview role can export the complete saved module workspace; the shared backup codecs take complete state and no actor argument. Combined export includes all three complete workspaces without a preview identity.
included: Saved HR performance self-review and manager drafts, survey draft answers, fictional rate timelines, chosen payroll periods, time-return reasons, payroll snapshots and mock receipts where present.
Unpublished CMS drafts and review metadata; CRM records belonging to other representatives.
excluded: Unsaved form inputs, running timers, restore-point history and the separate SDK mock session.
exportBoundary.authority: Readable JSON backups and synthetic role choices do not authenticate a person, grant Firebase claims or tenant membership, or authorize provider access. Production export needs its own trusted actor, resource and field policy.
